text: Sirkooɓe ɓen wi'i: Hanno jippinee e Muhammadu maandeeji immorde ka Joomi makko sugu ɗen jippinooɗe e Nulaaɓe adinooɓe mo ɓen? Maakan an Nulaaɗo: Anndee maandeej ɗin, ko e Juuɗe Alla woni. Himo jippina ɗi nde O muuyi woo, wanaa min ɗum wonani. Min on, ko mi jertinoowo on e lepte Alla ɗen, ɓannguɗo jertinol.
